lead: Eli Lilly / LLY — The FDA hands the crowd Zepbound
smaller: Upstart / UPST — The rate-relief darling gives the rally back
Roblox / RBLX — Kids' playground turns into a cash register
AMC Entertainment / AMC — Barbenheimer hands the meme crowd a win
why_lead: The FDA approval of Lilly's tirzepatide for weight loss as Zepbound is the day's dominant popular narrative, newly published on 2023-11-08 across CNBC, STAT, Reuters, NPR, NBC News and WIRED (n0821, n1785, n1792, n1789, n1790, n1799), with mass-market attention (n1790, n1730, n0688) and visible supply-constrained demand (n1760, n1697). Lilly rose 3.20% to 619.13 USD (+11.66% over five sessions) while Novo's ADR (+0.07%) and XLV (-0.14%) lagged, so the bid was company-specific. Smart-money split: BofA and Goldman bullish (n0271, n1727) against packaged-food and packaging skeptics (n1755, n1801) and competitive pricing (n0853).
why_smaller: Upstart: -27.30% to 21.38 USD after results (n0920, n0664), with Robinhood -14.29% on a newly reported drop in trading revenue and users (n0893) and Klaviyo -15.29%: the rate-relief rally's weakest names failing their earnings test even as the 10Y fell 28 bps over five observations.

Roblox: +11.83% to 39.22 USD (+23.49% over 20 sessions) on a bookings beat and higher in-game spending (n0895, n0896) with video-game sympathy (n0923); the GQ grow-up question and Apple's platform ambitions (n0576, n0779) supply the break. A gaming-engagement narrative distinct from health care, fintech and meme stocks.

AMC: material update to the 2023-11-01 smaller item on newly published results, a revenue beat on a 'Barbenheimer' boost (n0761), with Dumb Money culture (n0815) and Bloomberg's China dragon-zodiac meme craze (n0185); the $10 turnaround question (n0513) and GameStop's -16.06% 20-session slide supply the break.

considered_not_chosen.reason: Below-consensus forecast with shares diving 8% (n0104) is a post-session move not in the completed 2023-11-08 session (-1.57%); AI led on 2023-11-02 and 2023-11-07, so the AI-IPO angle was not given a slot.
Smaller trade on 2023-11-08; Rivian-surges/Lucid-dips and Amazon-exclusivity coverage (n0889, n0888, n0817) adds little to that item and RIVN fell 2.41% in the completed session.
Miners fell 6.86% to 7.27% while bitcoin rose 0.60%, but there is no newly published miner-specific headline; crypto rested again for variety.
Shares popped on the Zelda movie (n0872) but Nintendo is not a writer-card instrument; used only as sympathy context via n0923 in the Roblox item.
Better-than-expected profit and a bigger cost-cutting plan (n0812) arrived after the completed session (-0.11%); an institutional turnaround story without retail-attention evidence.
Lead on 2023-11-08; fell a further 2.64% to 75.33 USD/bbl with no materially new catalyst, so the unchanged theme was not repeated.

selection_memory.lead_material_change: Lilly led on 2023-11-03 (earnings and demand) and appeared as a smaller material-update item on 2023-11-07 (reported loss). It returns as lead only on newly published regulatory evidence: the FDA approval of tirzepatide for weight loss as Zepbound (n0821, n1785, n1792, n1789, n1790, n1799), plus the competitive-pricing plan (n0853), all published 2023-11-08 after the 2023-11-07 cutoff. The narrative shifts from demand to a second approved consumer brand and a price contest with Novo. Robinhood (smaller 2023-11-08) appears only inside the Upstart item, on its newly published reaction (n0893). AMC returns as a smaller material update on newly published results (n0761).
